description: About The Opportunity Join a globally connected team driving the future of finance technology at scale. As a Finance Modules Product Manager, you’ll shape and deliver critical finance system capabilities that power automation, control, and operational excellence across multiple markets. This is a high-impact role working across Finance, Technology, and Operations to unlock efficiency and innovation in mid- and back-office finance processes. You’ll own the product lifecycle, influence strategy, and deliver meaningful outcomes that enhance the way finance operates globally. It is imperative that you have strong knowledge of the modules in Microsoft Dynamics 365 for this role. Key Responsibilities • Own and drive the global product roadmap for finance system modules within the Finance Systems domain • Define standard finance module capabilities while supporting local regulatory and operational requirements • Prioritise enhancements based on automation impact, risk reduction, and finance productivity • Align finance module strategy with broader Finance Systems and corporate technology roadmaps • Use data and insights to define KPIs and track product success • Define and deliver system-supported finance processes including reconciliation, exception management, and intercompany processing • Partner with Transactional Finance teams to translate process needs into automated workflows • Ensure strong financial controls including auditability, traceability, and segregation of duties • Lead end-to-end product delivery from discovery through to release, adoption, and optimisation • Translate business and finance requirements into epics, user stories, and product specifications • Collaborate with technical SMEs, engineers, and vendors to deliver scalable, reliable solutions • Ensure seamless integration with invoicing, payments, and reporting platforms • Enable exception-based operations and reduce manual processing • Analyse trends and drive continuous improvement initiatives • Support L2/L3 teams with product knowledge and defect prioritisation • Ensure compliance with audit and regulatory requirements across markets • Act as the primary product interface for finance stakeholders • Coordinate with other product managers to deliver end-to-end process consistency • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive. Experience & Qualifications • Proven experience in product management roles focused on finance systems, ERP modules, or back-office platforms • Experience in corporate TMC, travel technology, or complex multi-entity environments (preferred) • Hands-on experience with finance process automation and control frameworks • Experience working with ERP platforms such as Dynamics 365 • Demonstrated experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments • Strong collaboration across Finance, Technology, and Operations teams • Degree in technology, finance, or a related field (preferred) What's In It For You? (Please note that the benefits may vary by region / country) A welcoming team : Become part of a friendly, collaborative team where everyone is on a first-name basis. Flat hierarchies and autonomy : We combine flat hierarchies with plenty of personal responsibility, giving you room to showcase your skills and make an impact. Professional growth : Benefit from excellent training and development opportunities, as well as the chance to work with our international teams. Flexible hybrid work culture : Remote work is part of our DNA. Our modern, centrally located to our Bordeaux or Paris office provides an inspiring space whenever you want to work on-site.. Employee stock program : Participate in our company's success and growth through our employee stock program. Health & wellbeing : Take advantage of our health initiatives including company runs, wellness workshops, challenges and more. Exciting events : Join us at local and international events – our way of saying thank you for your great work. Travel perks : As part of an international travel company, you'll enjoy exclusive travel-related discounts and appealing benefits. Our number one philosophy is Our people. Flight Centre Travel Group's promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which reflects the diversity of our society. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at RecruitmentUK@flightcentre.co.uk

description: Why work for us: At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future, a more connected, more inclusive, and more sustainable world. We believe technology is only as powerful as the people using it to create a better tomorrow: Role Purpose: We are seeking a strategic and technically adept Microsoft Product Manager to lead the development, delivery, and lifecycle management of our Microsoft product portfolio. This role is pivotal in shaping the future of how our customers communicate and collaborate and is a key growth area for Vodafone Business. Vodafone is a Microsoft Direct CSP Partner, assisting customers with their cloud transformation in AI Business Solutions and Cloud and AI Platforms and resell Microsoft services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure as part of the Vodafone portfolio. As the Microsoft Product Manager, you will be responsible for managing existing and developing new Microsoft product offerings for Vodafone Business. You will manage our Microsoft portfolio, including products such as Microsoft 365 and Azure, while working with the Group Product, Strategic Partners, and Marketplace teams to launch new Microsoft products that help scale Vodafone’s business. The role is growth-focused and involves developing Microsoft product opportunities, growing existing revenues, and jointly creating business plans with Sales and Go-To-Market teams. The role will work with and be supported by the Partner Management and Digital Services teams. The role interacts closely with our Group Microsoft Product Management teams that oversee our Group Product Portfolio. Essence of Role – Key Accountabilities: Product Strategy & Growth Manage and grow an existing Microsoft product portfolio, including Microsoft 365 and Azure Identify new Microsoft product opportunities and drive portfolio expansion. This can include additional services that support the Microsoft Portfolio Contribute to business planning aligned with Vodafone’s growth strategy Product Development & Lifecycle Management Develop and launch new Microsoft products using the Vodafone Product Development Processes (Product Operating Model) Manage the lifecycle of existing Microsoft products to drive revenue growth Customer Engagement & Performance Act as the voice of the customer, gathering feedback through direct engagement, surveys, and usage analytics Collaborate with sales, go to market, commercial, strategic partners and operational teams to ensure product-market fit and successful go-to-market execution Define KPIs and success metrics; track product performance and iterate based on data insights Drive continuous improvement in product quality, user experience, and operational efficiency Go-To-Market & Commercial Execution Work with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to develop and execute product plans that drive sales growth Support positioning of Vodafone solutions to customers, including C-level stakeholders Stakeholder & Partner Management Collaborate with Group Product, Strategic Partners, Sales and the Vodafone Ireland Leadership teams Support joint initiatives with Microsoft and internal Vodafone teams Work closely with the Vodafone Marketplace teams supporting the sale and lifecycle management of Microsoft products Prioritise system or product issues using factual data Compliance & Security Ensure the portfolio meets regulatory, security, and data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001) We Are Looking For You, If You Have 5-10 years’ experience in Product Management including experience in developing, proving, and selling the customer business case. Degree/HNC/HND or equivalent qualification ideally relating to marketing, business, economics, or technical discipline Knowledge of Microsoft Products and Services Has worked with senior functional stakeholders to align with their product strategy and requirements. Highly proficient at managing market strategy and commercial requirements for product/s. Has managed P&L and commercials for their product. Excellent product knowledge particularly at the Ireland Market level. Can spot product and technology trends. Can demonstrate a good understanding of key enabling product technologies. Experience At Resolving Conflicting Requirements. Requires particular focus on customers/customer-facing. Able to manage and understand local and global customer trends. Experience and interest in delivering flawless customer experience processes for your products. Relationship Management, Influencing Skills And Contract Negotiation Experience Not a perfect fit? Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply — you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity What’s in it for you? The flexibility to work how you perform best, with hybrid ways of working and real focus on work-life balance A competitive package including salary, bonus and a strong pension to support you now and long-term ‘’Generous’’ flexible benefits allowance, plus access to comprehensive health and wellbeing support Access to our on-site wellness centre and gym, alongside a wider wellbeing programme Free mobile plan, device offers and exclusive discounts for you, your family and friends Market-leading family policies and flexibility to support you at every stage of life Real opportunities for career growth through learning, development and internal progression Who we are: We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people’s lives and the world around us. Through our technology, we empower people — connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live — and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same. Belonging at Vodafone isn’t a concept; it’s lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You’ll be part of a global and diverse community with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. We’re committed to increasing diversity, ensuring equal representation, and making Vodafone a place where everyone feels safe, valued and included. Vodafone is committed to supporting candidates with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know. ________________________________________ Together we can.

description: About Origin Medical Research Lab Origin Medical Research Lab is the research arm of Origin Medical. Here, we strive to bring together the best and brightest minds at the intersection of AI and healthcare to fulfill Origin Medical’s mission. By combining the knowledge of healthcare and AI, it is on a journey to build state-of-the-art solutions aimed at supporting a broad spectrum of healthcare providers in rural and urban communities, allowing them to practice at the top of their licenses. With AI in the imaging workflow, clinicians can more confidently deliver timely interventions, enhance pregnancy outcomes, identify high-risk pregnancies to reduce maternal mortality, and significantly lower infant mortality rates. Origin Medical, headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA, is driven by a mission to advance maternal health equity by improving access to quality prenatal care with artificial intelligence. About the Product Team and the Role The Associate Product Manager will take on meaningful end-to-end ownership of product modules or features across Origin Medical's suite of AI-enabled healthcare solutions. The role involves independently driving product decisions, leading cross-functional collaboration, and contributing to strategic initiatives. This position is designed for product professionals ready to step into greater ownership and build the skills needed to advance toward a full Product Manager role. What You Will Do Product Ownership Own defined product modules or feature areas end-to-end — from ideation and requirement definition through to testing, launch, and iteration Develop and maintain product roadmaps for your area, aligning them with the broader product strategy and organizational goals Define, track, and report on product success metrics to inform continuous improvement Strategy & Discovery Lead stakeholder interviews, user research, and gap analyses to surface unmet clinical needs and translate them into clear product opportunities Conduct competitive and market analyses to inform product positioning and prioritization decisions Collaborate closely with design on user experience — contributing to wireframes, prototypes, and design validation with end users Cross-Functional Execution Serve as the primary liaison between clinical stakeholders, engineering, and design for your product area — translating complex clinical needs into precise, actionable requirements Proactively manage timelines, surface blockers, and coordinate across teams to keep development on track Lead and contribute to testing phases, defining acceptance criteria and monitoring quality outcomes Drive deployment readiness for your product modules, including stakeholder communication and operational planning Culture Contribute to building a strong product culture — championing user-centricity, clarity of thinking, and high standards of execution Who We Are Looking For At least 2  years of experience in a product management or closely related role is required Demonstrated ability to independently own a product area or feature set from concept to launch is preferred Experience in healthtech, medtech, or AI-driven products is preferred Experience with clinical environments or medical device workflows is preferred Experience with Figma or similar prototyping tools is preferred Working at Origin Medical Research Lab You will receive competitive monthly compensation aligned with industry standards. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive benefits package, including: Provident fund Paid annual leave Sick leaves Wellness allowance Insurance allowance You will work with an exceptional team of highly qualified individuals who strive towards a common goal of delivering a product that improves the standard of care for expecting mothers everywhere. You will also collaborate with renowned clinicians, AI scientists, and business leaders from around the world. At Origin Medical Research Lab, we take pride in fostering an inclusive and optimistic company culture that places great value on collaboration, teamwork, and work-life balance. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to join a supportive environment where individuals genuinely care about each other's success and well-being. Our dedicated colleagues are always ready to lend a helping hand and wish you nothing but the best in your professional journey. This job posting is valid only on our official LinkedIn page and the mentioned URL. We are not responsible for any job postings or advertisements on third-party sites not listed above. Please note that our company does not charge any fees for internships or job applications. Any such requests for payment should be considered fraudulent. We strongly advise you to report any suspicious activity involving our name to the appropriate authorities. Any unauthorized use of our job postings, company information, or data by third parties for their business activities is strictly prohibited. Such actions may be in violation of the Information Technology Act and will be subject to legal penalties under applicable laws. The information provided in this job posting outlines the general nature of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, or skills required. description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. As a Product Manager , you'll be a member of a small high-performing team that is re-imagining the way we do business. The Product Manager is responsible for working with business, customers, and technical stakeholders to facilitate the capture of end-end requirements to establish and deliver the product roadmap. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work across multiple teams to ensure alignment. You will function as the voice of the customer within cross-functional team settings to ensure products deliver customer value. In addition, you will be responsible for selling products to external clients and consultants. Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model. Primary Responsibilities Develop and enhance products that address customer needs and priorities, creating solutions that truly make an impact Collaborate with diverse teams to keep the customer perspective at the heart of every decision Manage the full product lifecycle, from initial concept through deployment, support, and change management Partner with business teams to identify opportunities for product and service improvements Evaluate solutions strategically, ensuring seamless integration and balancing value against cost throughout development Communicate product vision and roadmap clearly to stakeholders and leadership Manage ongoing product performance, expansion, financial health, roadmap, and end-of-life decisions as appropriate Serve as the product champion and apply deep expertise to credibly represent, manage and engage with business(es) Contribute to team success, sharing knowledge and supporting growth across the organization Ability to present to external clients and consultants You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience Proven experience in project management and collaboration with cross-functional teams Demonstrated in-depth understanding of customer-centric product design and development Demonstrated success managing and delivering large, complex, multi-stakeholder programs Proven experience in product strategy or capability management Proven ability to sell products to external customers Preferred Qualifications Proven experience within Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) or healthcare environments Demonstrated knowledge of Agile software development methodologies Demonstrated solid understanding of pricing, billing, or financial systems Proven experience in operations, healthcare pricing, network management, healthcare economics, or a related discipline Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application. At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission. Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: Optum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age, race, and membership of the Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by law. Optum is a drug-free workplace. © 2026 Optum Services (Ireland) Limited. All rights reserved. #BBMEMEA

description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake's Developer Platform team is on a mission to win the hearts and minds of developers by making it seamless and intuitive to build with data. This is a role for a product manager who is passionate about building the foundational tools and infrastructure that power the developer experience on Snowflake and wants to take ownership of mission-critical features. The Developer Platform's vision is to deliver an exceptional, developer-first experience built on a foundation of simplicity, familiarity, and ease of use. The Client Side Interfaces group owns the connectivity and programmatic surfaces through which developers, data engineers, and automation systems interact with Snowflake — including the Terraform provider, Snow CLI, Tableau connector, and SQLAlchemy dialect. As a PM on this team, you will take ownership of a specific feature area and be responsible for the end-to-end product lifecycle, partnering closely with a dedicated engineering team to translate high-level strategy into a concrete roadmap and ship features that solve real, complex developer problems. As a Product Manager on the Developer Platform, you will: Own the product backlog and day-to-day execution for a key feature area of the Client Side Interfaces portfolio. Translate product strategy into detailed requirements, user stories, and clear specifications for your engineering team. Become the subject matter expert for your product, serving as the go-to resource for engineering, marketing, sales, and the developer community. Define, track, and analyze the metrics that measure the success and adoption of your products — using data to inform prioritization, not just report on it. Partner with senior product leaders to ensure your feature roadmap aligns with our broader strategic goals. Engage directly with the developer community — through interviews, dogfooding, and community feedback — to deeply understand workflows, pain points, and unmet needs. Our ideal product manager will have: 3-5 years of product management experience, with a proven track record of shipping products or features for a developer-facing tool, cloud service, or technical infrastructure product. We will also consider candidates with 5+ years of engineering experience in developer tools who are looking to transition into product management. A strong understanding of the modern software development lifecycle, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), and API design principles. The ability to be a "technically credible partner" to engineering — capable of engaging in deep discussions about product architecture, trade-offs, and implementation approaches. Deep empathy for developers, particularly those working with data, and a passion for solving their most frustrating workflow challenges. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align both technical and non-technical stakeholders around a shared vision. Strong analytical thinking and comfort with metrics — you use data to inform decisions and measure impact. Bonus points for: A technical degree (CS or Engineering) or equivalent software engineering experience. Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, or Terraform. Prior experience working on connectivity tools, developer SDKs, APIs, or programmatic interfaces. Experience building or contributing to an open-source developer community. Why join our Developer Platform team at Snowflake: This is an opportunity to take ownership of mission-critical components of a major developer platform used by millions. You will have the autonomy to drive features from concept to launch, with direct and measurable impact on nearly every Snowflake customer. This is the right role for a PM who is ready to apply strong product instincts to complex, high-impact technical problems — with the scope and visibility to grow into a senior IC role. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
title: Product Manager - Developer Platform

description: Wil jij bijdragen aan het verbeteren, standaardiseren en versnellen van onze carrier-integraties? Als Product Owner bouw je mee aan onze Service Orchestrator en aan herbruikbare oplossingen voor carrier-integraties. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat verschillende businessmodellen slimmer gebruik kunnen maken van bestaande oplossingen en nieuwe functionaliteit sneller beschikbaar komt. Daarom kies je als Product Owner Service Orchestrator en Integrations voor PostNL Zichtbaar werk Jij zorgt ervoor dat verschillende businessmodellen sneller en eenvoudiger gebruik kunnen maken van carrier-integraties. Dankzij jouw verbeteringen aan de Service Orchestrator en herbruikbare integratiecomponenten kunnen bestaande oplossingen breder worden ingezet en wordt nieuwe functionaliteit sneller beschikbaar. Uitdaging Jij vertaalt complexe businessbehoeften en vraagstukken rondom carrier-integraties naar schaalbare IT-oplossingen. Daarbij zoek je continu naar de juiste balans tussen standaardisatie, hergebruik, snelheid en de specifieke behoeften van verschillende businessmodellen. Goede sfeer Je werkt samen met collega’s die kansen durven te pakken, kennis delen en elkaar vooruithelpen. Flexibiliteit Flexibele werktijden ondersteunen een goede werk-privébalans. Je werkt hybride: thuis en in ons bruisende, hypermoderne kantoor in het historische Stationsgebouw naast station Den Haag HS. Verantwoordelijkheid Jij zet de koers uit voor de Service Orchestrator en de verdere ontwikkeling van herbruikbare oplossingen voor carrier-integraties. Je bepaalt prioriteiten en maakt samen met stakeholders keuzes over ontwikkeling, hergebruik en onderhoud. Ontwikkelkansen Je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf uit te dagen en verder te ontwikkelen in een internationaal en veranderend IT-landschap. Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, IT en architectuur en krijgt te maken met complexe integratievraagstukken. Dit is jouw rol Als Product Owner geef jij richting aan de ontwikkeling van de Service Orchestrator en onze aanpak voor herbruikbare carrier-integraties. Je zorgt ervoor dat verschillende businessmodellen eenvoudiger gebruik kunnen maken van bestaande integraties en dat nieuwe functionaliteit sneller beschikbaar komt. Het uitgangspunt is om oplossingen zoveel mogelijk één keer te ontwikkelen en, waar dat waarde toevoegt, door meerdere businessmodellen te laten gebruiken. Jij helpt bepalen waar standaardisatie en hergebruik mogelijk zijn en waar juist ruimte nodig is voor specifieke behoeften. Je werkt daarbij vanuit een langetermijnvisie op standaardisatie en hergebruik, maar kiest op korte termijn bewust voor een pragmatische aanpak. Door nieuwe oplossingen in de praktijk te toetsen, kunnen we sneller waarde leveren, aannames valideren en leren van implementaties. Jij vertaalt deze inzichten vervolgens naar de verdere koers en prioritering van de Service Orchestrator en onze integratieoplossingen. Samen met de business bepaal je wat als eerste wordt opgepakt. Je brengt behoeften en afhankelijkheden in kaart, maakt afwegingen tussen verschillende belangen en zorgt ervoor dat het ontwikkelteam duidelijke prioriteiten heeft. Je houdt de voortgang in de gaten en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen aantoonbare waarde toevoegen. Daarbij werk je veel samen met collega’s binnen Spring, verschillende businessmodellen, IT- en architectuurteams en externe IT-partners. Je bent betrokken bij initiatieven rondom gedeelde carrier-integraties en helpt de resultaten daarvan te vertalen naar concrete keuzes voor verdere ontwikkeling. Deze rol vraagt daarmee om meer dan alleen backlogmanagement. Je begrijpt hoe businessbehoeften, informatiestromen en IT-oplossingen met elkaar samenhangen en kunt hierover op verschillende niveaus het gesprek voeren. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen ontwikkelteams, architecten, productmanagement en senior stakeholders en weet complexe onderwerpen terug te brengen tot heldere keuzes. Dit bezorgen we jou Wij geloven dat tevreden medewerkers zorgen voor tevreden klanten. Daarom kun je in deze functie rekenen op: Een goed salaris tot maximaal € 6.890 bruto per maand in schaal 11, op basis van een 39,25-urige werkweek. Een uitdagende werkomgeving binnen een groeiend, innovatief bedrijf met een open en energieke cultuur. Een netto thuiswerkvergoeding van € 45 per maand als je minimaal twee dagen per week vanuit huis werkt. 8% vakantiegeld en 25 vakantiedagen als je fulltime werkt. Een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer, via een NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding. Een goede pensioenregeling via ons pensioenfonds. Alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen, zoals een laptop en smartphone. Dit breng je mee Je bent een echte verbinder die overzicht houdt, verschillende belangen bij elkaar brengt en beslissingen durft te nemen. Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je vindt het wel interessant om te begrijpen hoe systemen, informatiestromen en integraties met elkaar samenhangen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel: Je hebt een hbo- of wo-diploma, bij voorkeur in business of IT. Je hebt minimaal drie jaar ervaring als Product Owner, Product Manager of Solution Consultant. Je hebt goede kennis van IT-processen en affiniteit met technische en complexe integratievraagstukken. Je kunt businessbehoeften vertalen naar heldere prioriteiten en richting voor IT-teams. Je bent in staat om op verschillende niveaus te communiceren, van ontwikkelteams en architecten tot productmanagement en senior stakeholders. Je hebt interesse in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende businessmodellen, systemen en belangen samenkomen. Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Je bent proactief, analytisch en kunt goed omgaan met een dynamische omgeving waarin niet alles vooraf vaststaat. Nog wat laatste post ... Tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure voeren we een achtergrondcheck uit. Dit bestaat uit een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG). Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van de procedure. Hiermee brengen we jouw competenties en vaardigheden in kaart. We werven zelf onze nieuwe collega’s. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

description: Demand Generation Marketing Manager - Drive Organisational Growth High-impact role with real ownership & autonomy Shape demand generation and marketing strategy Become a key player shaping our expansion Archer is expanding. description: This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client. Role type: Full time Location: Remote Working with: CEO and Cofounder Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them. About The Role This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't. You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back-to-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you. What you'll actually do On any given day you might be: Running the full inside-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO) Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides. What we're looking for You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow-ups needed You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow-up you skip is the deal you lose You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand-holding, no fully-defined role. The role is what you make it What you get Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front-row seat to how a profitable, venture-backed startup grows The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it The kind of zero-to-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description: Join us in solving one of industrial robotics' toughest challenges. R3 Robotics is developing the AI-powered dismantling platform that transforms end-of-life electric vehicle systems into strategic sources of critical materials. As global electrification accelerates, the surge in batteries and e-motors requires automated solutions that manual disassembly cannot provide. We are addressing this industrial bottleneck by enabling the automated dismantling of complex systems at scale through computer vision, artificial intelligence, and specialized robotic tooling. Following a successful €20M Series A funding round led by HG Ventures and Suma Capital, we are expanding across Europe and preparing for our entry into the United States market in 2026. We partner with major industrial recyclers and automotive OEMs to deliver measurable impact. If you seek to work on advanced robotics within a well-funded organization scaling internationally, this is your opportunity. Your role You will own R3's marketing execution and support CRM operations: from our website and social channels to HubSpot data hygiene, lead funnel execution, and reporting; helping tell R3's story to the market and keeping our commercial data clean and actionable. This is a full-time role based in Luxembourg, reporting directly to the Head of Business Operations. Your responsibilities Own and drive R3's LinkedIn presence - drafting, scheduling, and publishing content, and managing the wider website and social media presence. Support R3's SEO strategy - keyword research, on-page optimization, content planning, and performance tracking. Produce and schedule content, and support event and campaign communications. Own CRM (HubSpot) data hygiene, reporting, and pipeline dashboards. Execute the lead funnel - MQL identification, scoring, nurture sequences, and handoff to the commercial team; report on funnel performance and provide insights and recommendations to improve conversion. Track and analyse marketing and commercial data, turning it into clear insights for the team. Coordinate with external agencies and freelancers where relevant. Your profile ~2 years' experience in a marketing role; communications or operations experience a plus. Hands-on with website tools and social media; comfortable drafting content independently. Working knowledge of SEO principles and tools (e.g., Google Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, or similar). Experience with lead funnel/demand-gen execution (MQL scoring, nurture flows) a plus. Strong with data and analytics — comfortable turning numbers into insight. CRM experience, HubSpot strongly preferred. Solid communication skills, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and able to deal with ambiguity. Fluent English; German or French a plus. Why us? High degree of collaboration and autonomy while working with a group of highly skilled, committed and supportive peers Transparent culture where everyone is highly valued Development of your professional skills and knowledge by taking ownership of challenging tasks and responsibilities, supported by leads and peers “Getting things done” attitude, and access to cutting edge technologies Complementary Health Insurance

description: We are Ahead We're building Europe's fastest-growing AI-powered preventive health platform - live in Switzerland, Germany and The Netherlands and expanding across Europe, fast. Growth is the engine behind that ambition. Your mission: own the entire Ahead growth funnel, from the first ad someone sees to the member who renews a year later, and make it the most efficient, compounding growth engine in preventive health. You'll be the single owner of our growth channels: acquisition, conversion, lifecycle, retention, pushing us to acquire faster, convert better, and retain longer. You’ll work directly with our founders, marketing, product, design and medical team. No layers. No BS. High trust, and high expectations. We're looking for someone smart, data-driven and who knows how to code. Think: the rigour of a clinical brand with the pulse of a consumer product, and a person who'll do whatever it takes to drive our memberships. We're backed by founders and execs from Coolblue, Hugging Face, Cradle, Google, DeepMind, Oviva, Stanford Medicine, GE, Philips, and Coda. Your role Personalised, preventive healthcare has historically been a luxury. AI changes that. Ahead Health raised its Seed round with great investors and is now scaling. As our Full-stack DTC growth marketer, you own the entire funnel, from the first engagement to the member who renews a year later. We point you at the goal; you decide the path: channels, campaigns, experiments, whatever moves the number. The surface is broad: paid acquisition on one side; SEO, CRM and lifecycle - onboarding, activation, retention, win-back. You do the hands-on work yourself, without agencies, and you instrument everything as you go: event tracking, dashboards, attribution. You work directly with the founders, product, design, and medical team. No layers slowing you down. Growing a consumer health brand carries dimensions you won't find in a typical growth role. Every claim in every communication has to hold to a clinical-grade bar. You market a product built on sensitive health data, which means trust isn't a brand value, it's a conversion factor: privacy, transparency, and rigor shape how you acquire. Responsibilities End-to-end funnel ownership: Drive the full growth lifecycle, including acquisition, conversion, CRM, and retention. Responsible for the path forward, the channels, the experiments, and the final results Performance & lifecycle: Scale high-impact acquisition assets and build robust lifecycle strategies (onboarding, activation, retention, win-back) to maximise member lifetime value Experimentation & optimisation: Systematically identify and fix funnel leaks, eliminating ineffective approaches and scaling successful ones Technical execution: Build and maintain an analytics stack. Utilise event tracking, SQL, and automation tools to ensure data accuracy and clear attribution without reliance on external support Strategy & AI integration: Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, copy, operations, and analysis while maintaining high standards for rigor and clinical accuracy Need to have 5+ years in growth or growth marketing, with at least 2 years at a DTC, subscription, or consumer-product brand where you owned a number A true full-funnel operator - comfortable moving between paid, SEO, CRM/lifecycle, and conversion in a single week, and doing the hands-on work yourself You’ve (AI) coded things before: event tracking, automations Data-driven by default: fluent in analytics and attribution, can build your own dashboards, and lets the numbers settle the argument Demonstrably fast: ships experiments in days, not weeks, and iterates on what the data says Uses AI tools to move faster and do more - research, copy, analysis - without losing judgment. Fluent in English; comfortable working across our DACH-first markets Great to have German fluency (a strong plus for our Swiss and DACH markets); French a bonus SEO depth - technical SEO, content strategy, or programmatic Experience at an early-stage or growth team, building from scratch Experience with health, wellness, or consumer biotech brands To apply , send a short note on why Ahead Health, plus 2–3 growth results you're most proud of - the channel, what you did, and the metric you moved (with numbers). No cover letters.

Our ambition is much bigger than building another successful DTC company. We're building Mellow into a global consumer brand and assembling a world-class growth organization capable of operating at massive scale. We're now expanding our growth team in Bengaluru and looking for exceptional operators who want to help build what comes next. The Role We're hiring Senior Growth Managers to own and scale meaningful areas of Mellow's growth engine. This is not a traditional marketing management position . We want a hands-on growth operator who understands how acquisition, creative, CRO, merchandising, offers, retention, and unit economics work together to drive profitable growth. You'll work closely with Mellow's leadership and growth teams, move quickly, test aggressively, analyze performance deeply, and be expected to identify opportunities before someone asks you to. We care much more about what you've actually built and scaled than your current title. What You'll Own Drive profitable growth across major acquisition channels Develop and execute growth strategies across Meta, Google, TikTok and emerging channels Work closely with creative teams to continuously improve advertising performance Identify opportunities across landing pages, funnels, offers, merchandising and CRO Analyze performance across CAC, MER, ROAS, AOV, CVR, LTV and contribution margin Build testing roadmaps and turn insights into action quickly Find new channels, strategies and opportunities for incremental growth Help build the systems, processes and team required to operate at significantly greater scale Work cross-functionally with creative, product, finance, retention, analytics and leadership Take ownership of problems rather than waiting for direction Who We're Looking For You may currently be a Director of Growth, Head of Growth, Growth Lead, Performance Marketing Lead, or an exceptional Senior Growth Manager ready for significantly more responsibility. description: About Kim.cc Kim.cc is building the future of AI-powered customer support for Shopify brands. We're not looking for someone to optimise an existing paid marketing engine. We're looking for someone to build one. This is a true 0→1 role where your job is to discover what works — from messaging and positioning to channels, creatives and landing pages — and build a repeatable paid acquisition engine. If you enjoy running experiments, challenging assumptions and building new growth systems from scratch, you'll fit right in. What You'll Own You will own paid acquisition as a business problem, not just an advertising channel. Your goal is to discover a scalable and repeatable paid acquisition engine that generates qualified pipeline. This includes: • Forming hypotheses around messaging, ICP, offers and acquisition channels. • Designing and running rapid experiments to validate those hypotheses. • Planning, launching and optimising campaigns across channels such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads and other relevant platforms. • Building and iterating landing pages, conversion flows and offers in partnership with design and content. • Working closely with founders and product marketing to continuously refine positioning based on campaign learnings. • Owning tracking, attribution and analytics so every experiment produces actionable insights. • Building dashboards to measure funnel performance from click through to qualified pipeline. • Identifying when an experiment is not working and making fast, evidence-based decisions to pivot or stop. • Documenting learnings and building repeatable playbooks as the channel matures. Success in This Role Success is not measured by ad spend, impressions or click-through rates. Success is measured by your ability to discover a repeatable paid acquisition engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline and creates a foundation for scaling. What We're Looking For • 3–6 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation or performance marketing. • Experience building or scaling acquisition in an early-stage B2B SaaS startup is preferred. • Strong understanding of paid channels including Google, LinkedIn and Meta. • Comfortable owning experimentation beyond media buying, including messaging, offers, landing pages and conversion optimisation. • Strong analytical skills with experience in attribution, funnel analysis and performance reporting. • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete data and iterating quickly. • High ownership mindset with strong commercial judgement. • Someone who naturally asks “Why isn't this working?” before asking “How do I optimise this campaign?” • Experience with Shopify or the ecommerce ecosystem is a bonus. How You'll Work This is a highly cross-functional role. You'll work closely with founders, product marketing, content and design to rapidly test ideas and convert learnings into scalable growth. You won't be expected to create every asset yourself, but you will be expected to own the outcome. Why Join Kim.cc? You'll have the opportunity to define how paid acquisition works from the ground up. You'll help shape our messaging, influence product positioning, discover scalable acquisition channels and build the foundation for long-term growth. If building something from zero excites you more than inheriting someone else's playbook, we'd love to meet you. Please drop CV at hireme@kim.cc
title: Growth Marketing Manager

description: Genoeg van plannen maken die later misschien werken? Help ons oplossingen bouwen die zeker werken! Premium is het adviesbureau waar jij als medewerker centraal staat! En dit terwijl je werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij interessante opdrachtgevers. Vanwege verdere groei zijn we op zoek naar business analisten die het verschil maken. Als business analist is elke opdracht anders. Zo realiseer je oplossingen die vaak te maken hebben met data, processen en IT gekoppeld aan de daarbij behorende Data Management en Governance inrichting. Je besteedt veel aandacht aan de mensen en de organisatie waarin ze werken. Zij zijn namelijk degene die de oplossing moeten gebruiken en de werkzaamheden mogen uitvoeren. Door de mens en hun kennis mee te nemen in je oplossing ben je ervan overtuigd dat alleen dan een structurele en duurzame oplossing ontstaat. We zoeken collega’s die zich snel kunnen aanpassen aan nieuwe situaties, nieuwsgierig zijn en zelf hun weg vinden wanneer ze voor een nieuwe uitdaging komen te staan of een lastig vraagstuk moeten oplossen. Wat bied jij? Een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding. Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende doelgroepen. Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt gestructureerd. Je werkt makkelijk samen met mensen die op een oplossing vragen, maar ook met de mensen die uiteindelijk de oplossing moeten gaan gebruiken. Je werkt graag met andere samen en voelt je snel in een nieuwe omgeving thuis. Wat bieden wij? Werkomgeving: Een informele, uitdagende en leuke werkomgeving en een gezonde balans tussen werk en vrije tijd. Groei: Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, door opleidingen en trainingen. Cultuur : We zijn eerlijk en open. We houden er van om plezier met elkaar te hebben. Regelmatig spreken we met elkaar af op kantoor en eten we samen. En een aantal keer per jaar organiseren we een leuk evenement. Bovendien kun je rekenen op uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een marktconform salaris, bonusregeling, 25 vakantiedagen en 5 dagen voor opleiding en een pensioenregeling Denk jij dat dit een mooie functie voor jou is en zou je er meer over willen weten?
